description: Agent Coordination: submit two or more collaborators’ recorded actions and decisions on the same job: each with its id, the agent, its kind (a commitment of a resource, an output, a decision, a reversal or other), the resource it commits or the subject it is about, what it says or decides, when it was taken, the action it reverses, whether an output shipped outside the group, the agents told about it and whether it was withdrawn; optionally the agents on the job; and the rule that settles a collision (the lead decides, the principal decides, the first claim wins, the agents vote, or no rule) with who decides. The signed report counts the live, reversed and withdrawn actions, lists every collision, and names direct collisions: the same resource committed twice, contradictory outputs shipped and a decision one agent reversed without telling the others; then decisions and unshipped outputs that diverge on one subject, no resolution rule and a lead or principal rule with no one to decide, with the fix for each. Collaborators here share one goal: parties with opposing interests stuck on terms are wever_negotiation-deadlock-check, and knowledge entries that contradict each other are wever_knowledge-conflict-check. Verdict collaborators_collide, collision_gaps, collisions_unverified or no_collisions. POST /api/coordination-conflict-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-coordination-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-coordination/.

actions.description: Each recorded action or decision on the job.

agent.description: The agent that took the action or decision.

kind.description: A commitment of a resource, an output, a decision, a reversal of an earlier action or decision, or other.

resource.description: What a commitment commits, such as the 3 PM demo slot or the Q4 budget line.

reverses.description: The id of the action or decision it reverses.

shipped.description: An output delivered outside the group, to a principal, a customer or a system.

subject.description: What an output or decision is about, such as the launch date.

value.description: What it says, decides or commits, such as November 20.

withdrawn.description: It was withdrawn or released before it took effect.

agents.description: The agents working on the job, to read who a reversal must reach.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

decider.description: Who decides under a lead or principal rule.

resolution.description: How a collision is settled: the lead decides, the principal decides, the first claim wins, the agents vote, or no rule.

name: wever_coordination-conflict-check
title: Coordination conflict check
